en: I'm the younger brother of the Pokémon Fan Club's chairman. I've come out to Pacifidlog for a long holiday.
Let me have a look at the Pokémon you're with...
Oh dear. It hasn't taken to you at all. A Pokémon like that should have this.
My, my! It simply adores you. A Pokémon like that deserves this.
Return hits harder the more a Pokémon loves its trainer. Frustration hits harder the less it does.
Hmm, neither here nor there. Spend more time together, and come back to show me.
Come back tomorrow, and I'll have another look at your Pokémon.
It looks very fond of its trainer.
It doesn't seem very fond of its trainer.
